name: Pixel Agent Status
description: Eight animated 9×9 pixel glyphs for what an AI agent is doing: thinking, searching, writing, listening, syncing, done, error and idle.
usage:
import { PixelStatus } from "@/components/design-for-ai/pixel-agent-status";

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered size in px. Under 28px dots thicken and the glow drops so it stays crisp.

props.name: color
props.description: Override the state's default colour (see STATE_COLORS).

props.name: grid
props.description: Show the faint unlit dots behind the glyph.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label; defaults to the state name.
